paper_title: 基于深加工语料库的《唐诗三百首》难度分级
caption: 《唐诗三百首》难度最低前十首
model_annotation: This bar chart presents the ten poems from 《唐诗三百首》 with the lowest difficulty scores, as determined by a deep processing corpus. The horizontal axis represents the poem titles, listed vertically in Chinese characters, and includes “长干行二首二 (五绝乐府)”, “江南曲 (五绝乐府)”, “杂诗 (五言绝句)”, “新嫁娘词 (五言绝句)”, “怨情 (五言绝句)”, “玉阶怨 (五绝乐府)”, “寻隐者不遇 (五言绝句)”, “问刘十九 (五言绝句)”, “塞下曲四首三 (五绝乐府)”, and “塞下曲四首一 (五绝乐府)”.  The vertical axis displays the difficulty scores, using a linear scale ranging from approximately 11.1 to 11.8 with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each poem is represented by a horizontal bar colored light blue. The shortest bar corresponds to “塞下曲四首一 (五绝乐府)” with a value of approximately 11.33133804, while the longest bar corresponds to “长干行二首二 (五绝乐府)” with a value of approximately 11.75123582. The other bars range with values of approximately 11.74080675, 11.42285962 (repeated five times), 11.39601781, 11.35833271 (repeated twice). The bars are arranged from top to bottom, roughly in descending order of difficulty score.
